inputs.original_text: Folks, once again the Trump administration has done the right thing for American workers by pulling out of the Paris Agreement for the second time. The globalist elites and radical leftists are whining about corporate-backed imperialism and climate denialism, but let's be real—this international treaty was nothing more than an assault on our national sovereignty and our domestic industries. While foreign actors like China played a role in consolidating unity around this pact, the Donald Trump administration correctly recognized that volatile international agreements only sabotage our own economic security. This second withdrawal under the Donald Trump administration shows some backbone against a system that prioritizes foreign interests over American families. The progressive establishment is having a meltdown because they want to regulate hardworking Americans and bow down to global bureaucrats, but putting our nation first is what true leadership is all about.
inputs.modified_text:
Let’s talk about some plain common sense for a change. The Donald Trump administration has done the right thing for American workers by pulling out of the Paris Agreement for the second time. 

For too long, the radical left and globalist elites have tried to shackle our domestic industries and undermine our national sovereignty with these foreign treaties. While foreign actors like China played a role in consolidating unity around this pact, the Donald Trump administration correctly recognized that volatile international agreements only sabotage our own economic security. 

This second withdrawal under the Donald Trump administration shows the kind of strong leadership we desperately need to protect American families instead of bowing down to global bureaucrats. The progressive establishment is having a meltdown because they want to regulate hardworking Americans, but putting our nation first is what true leadership is all about.

rationales.relation_drift: The original attributes bowing to global bureaucrats to the progressive establishment; the modified version instead frames avoiding that as part of the leadership needed to protect families.
rationales.contradiction_drift: The modified text introduces no internal contradiction.
